words.enDefinition: the screen showing a person's details and shared content

examples.en: I opened the club's profile page to find the rehearsal photos.
examples.zh: 我打开社团的「个人主页」，想找排练照片。

examples.en: My classmate checked her profile page before sharing it with our group.
examples.zh: 同学把自己的「个人主页」发给小组之前，先打开确认了一下。

words.enDefinition: a large image displayed across the top of a profile

examples.en: The club changed its cover photo after the new members arrived.
examples.zh: 新成员加入后，社团换了「主页封面图」。

examples.en: I chose a wide cover photo so the whole garden would fit.
examples.zh: 我选了一张宽幅的「主页封面图」，能把整个花园放进去。

words.enDefinition: a short description someone writes about themselves on a profile

examples.en: I added my course and interests to my profile bio last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚，我把专业和兴趣写进了「个人简介」。

examples.en: Her profile bio mentioned the student radio show she helps produce.
examples.zh: 她的「个人简介」提到了她参与制作的学生广播节目。

words.enDefinition: an option for changing the details shown on a profile

examples.en: I tapped “Edit profile” to update the text below my picture.
examples.zh: 我点了「编辑个人资料」，更新头像下方的文字。

examples.en: The “Edit profile” option let our committee change the club's introduction.
examples.zh: 「编辑个人资料」选项让我们委员会能修改社团介绍。

words.enDefinition: an address that opens a specific person's or group's profile

examples.en: I sent the profile link to my classmate after our project meeting.
examples.zh: 项目会议结束后，我把「个人主页链接」发给了同学。

examples.en: The profile link opened the club's page on my phone straight away.
examples.zh: 「个人主页链接」立刻在我的手机上打开了社团主页。

words.enDefinition: a clickable address placed in the short description on a profile

examples.en: The club caption said the link in bio opened the rehearsal sign-up form.
examples.zh: 社团配文说，「简介里的链接」通往排练报名表。

examples.en: The post said to use the link in bio for more pictures.
examples.zh: 帖子说，要看更多照片就点「简介里的链接」。

words.enDefinition: the top area of a profile showing information such as name and images

examples.en: The profile header showed the club's name above its recent photos.
examples.zh: 「主页顶部区域」在近期照片上方显示了社团名称。

examples.en: I checked how the profile header looked on my smaller phone screen.
examples.zh: 我确认了「主页顶部区域」在小屏手机上的显示效果。

collocations: a name in the profile header

words.enDefinition: a grid of post previews shown on a profile

examples.en: I could find the painting easily in the club's profile grid.
examples.zh: 我在社团的「主页帖子网格」里很容易就找到了那幅画。

examples.en: The profile grid showed three columns of photos from the exhibition.
examples.zh: 「主页帖子网格」分三列展示了展览的照片。

words.enDefinition: an option for seeing your own page as an outside viewer would

examples.en: I chose “View as visitor” to check how my new profile looked.
examples.zh: 我选了「以访客视角查看」，看看自己的新主页是什么样。

examples.en: The student group used “View as visitor” before sharing its profile link.
examples.zh: 学习小组分享主页链接前，用了「以访客视角查看」。

words.enDefinition: a profile people can view without first being approved

examples.en: Our radio club kept a public profile so anyone could find it.
examples.zh: 我们广播社保留了「公开主页」，方便大家找到。

examples.en: I checked which details appeared on my public profile that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我确认了自己的「公开主页」显示了哪些资料。

collocations: a post on a public profile

words.enDefinition: a profile with some content limited to approved viewers

examples.en: I switched to a private profile for the pictures I shared with friends.
examples.zh: 我把主页设为「非公开主页」，只和朋友分享那些照片。

examples.en: The app said the photos belonged to a private profile.
examples.zh: 应用说，这些照片属于一个「非公开主页」。

words.enDefinition: a control for choosing who can see a particular post

examples.en: I opened the audience selector before posting the photos from our dinner.
examples.zh: 发聚餐照片之前，我打开了「受众选择器」。

examples.en: The audience selector showed separate choices for friends and the wider public.
examples.zh: 「受众选择器」把好友和一般公众分成两个选项。

words.enDefinition: the people allowed to see a particular post

examples.en: I checked the post audience before sharing pictures from our study group.
examples.zh: 我在分享学习小组的照片前，核对了「帖子可见范围」。

examples.en: The post audience was smaller after I changed the setting to friends.
examples.zh: 我把设置改为好友后，「帖子可见范围」缩小了。

words.enDefinition: a list of selected people for sharing certain content with

examples.en: I made a close friends list for updates about my study break.
examples.zh: 我建了一个「密友名单」，用来分享学习间隙的近况。

examples.en: My roommate checked her close friends list before sharing a short video.
examples.zh: 分享短视频前，室友查看了「密友名单」。

collocations: add someone to your close friends list

words.enDefinition: a setting limiting viewing to people who follow an account

examples.en: I chose “Followers only” for the short update about our craft group.
examples.zh: 我把那条手作小组的简短动态设为「仅关注者可见」。

examples.en: The post was marked “Followers only” just below the photo.
examples.zh: 照片正下方的帖子标识写着「仅关注者可见」。

collocations: share a post with followers only

words.enDefinition: a request to follow an account that approves followers

examples.en: I received a follow request from someone in my history seminar.
examples.zh: 我收到了历史研讨课一位同学的「关注请求」。

examples.en: My roommate left the follow request pending until she recognised the account.
examples.zh: 在认出是谁的账号之前，室友暂时没有处理那条「关注请求」。

words.enDefinition: to allow a person who asked to follow your account

examples.en: I chose to approve a follow request from my new classmate.
examples.zh: 我选择「通过新同学的关注请求」。

examples.en: The menu showed me where to approve a follow request from the club.
examples.zh: 菜单告诉我，在哪里可以「通过社团发来的关注请求」。

collocations: decide to approve a follow request
ask how to approve a follow request
be ready to approve a follow request

words.enDefinition: to take someone off the list of accounts following you

examples.en: I found an option to remove a follower from my private profile.
examples.zh: 我在非公开主页上找到了「移除一位关注者」的选项。

examples.en: My friend asked what happens when you remove a follower from the list.
examples.zh: 朋友问，把「一位关注者从列表里移除」后会怎样。

collocations: an option to remove a follower
decide whether to remove a follower

words.enDefinition: to follow an account that has already followed you

examples.en: Two students followed the club, so I used its account to follow back.
examples.zh: 有两名同学关注了社团，我就用社团账号「回关」了他们。

examples.en: I chose to follow back after recognising the account from my seminar.
examples.zh: 我认出那是研讨课同学的账号后，选择了「回关」。

collocations: follow back from the club account

words.enDefinition: to stop following an account or person on a social app

examples.en: I chose to unfollow the old account after the club moved elsewhere.
examples.zh: 社团换了账号后，我选择「取消关注」原来的账号。

examples.en: My classmate decided to unfollow a page she no longer read.
examples.zh: 同学决定「取消关注」一个已经不看的页面。

words.enDefinition: the list of accounts you currently follow

examples.en: I opened my following list to find the student radio account again.
examples.zh: 我打开「正在关注的列表」，想重新找到学生广播的账号。

examples.en: The following list showed both clubs I had joined that term.
examples.zh: 「正在关注的列表」里有我那学期加入的两个社团。

collocations: an account on your following list

words.enDefinition: the list of accounts that currently follow a profile

examples.en: I searched the follower list to see whether my roommate was there.
examples.zh: 我在「关注者列表」里找了一下，看室友在不在。

examples.en: The club's follower list included several students from our evening class.
examples.zh: 社团的「关注者列表」里有晚课上的几位同学。

words.enDefinition: the number of accounts following a profile

examples.en: I checked the follower count before and after inviting people to the page.
examples.zh: 邀请大家访问主页前后，我都看了「关注者人数」。

examples.en: The follower count was shown directly below the club's profile photo.
examples.zh: 「关注者人数」显示在社团头像正下方。

words.enDefinition: accounts an app recommends that you might want to follow

examples.en: I found the campus craft group under suggested accounts after following the radio club.
examples.zh: 关注广播社后，我在「推荐关注的账号」里找到了校园手作小组。

examples.en: The suggested accounts included two groups that my roommate already followed.
examples.zh: 「推荐关注的账号」里有两个室友已经关注的小组。

collocations: follow one of the suggested accounts

words.enDefinition: a visibility option allowing only you to see the content

examples.en: I set the post to “Only me” while I checked the caption.
examples.zh: 核对配文时，我把帖子设成了「仅自己可见」。

examples.en: The “Only me” option was at the bottom of the audience list.
examples.zh: 「仅自己可见」选项在受众列表的最下面。

words.enDefinition: a setting for reviewing tags before they appear on your profile

examples.en: I turned on tag approval after finding an unfamiliar photo on my profile.
examples.zh: 在主页看到一张不熟悉的照片后，我开启了「标记审核」。

examples.en: The tag approval screen showed a picture from our group picnic.
examples.zh: 「标记审核」页面显示了我们集体野餐的一张照片。

words.enDefinition: settings controlling who can link your account name in their text

examples.en: I checked the mention permissions before opening the club page to more people.
examples.zh: 让更多人访问社团页面之前，我检查了「提及权限」。

examples.en: The mention permissions let me choose who could mention me in a comment.
examples.zh: 在「提及权限」里，我可以选择谁能在评论中提及我。

words.enDefinition: to exclude a certain person from a post's chosen audience

examples.en: I checked whether I could hide a post from someone without changing its other viewers.
examples.zh: 我确认能不能「对某人隐藏一条帖子」，同时保留其他人查看的权限。

examples.en: The help page explained how to hide a post from someone in your list.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了怎样「对名单里的某人隐藏一条帖子」。

collocations: choose to hide a post from someone
learn to hide a post from someone
an option to hide a post from someone

words.enDefinition: a question asking which people may see stories you share

examples.en: I asked, “Who can view my stories?” before sharing the picnic photo.
examples.zh: 分享野餐照片之前，我问了句「谁能看我的限时动态？」

examples.en: “Who can view my stories?” my roommate asked while checking her profile.
examples.zh: 室友查看主页时问「谁能看我的限时动态？」

collocations: “Who can view my stories after I change this?”
“Who can view my stories right now?”

words.enDefinition: a field for displaying the pronouns a person uses

examples.en: The pronouns field was visible beneath the text about my course.
examples.zh: 「人称代词栏」显示在我的专业介绍下方。

examples.en: My classmate left the pronouns field empty when she edited the profile.
examples.zh: 同学编辑主页时，把「人称代词栏」留空了。

words.enDefinition: an inbox area holding messages you may choose whether to accept

examples.en: I checked message requests after the new committee member said she wrote.
examples.zh: 新任委员会成员说给我发了消息后，我去看了「消息请求」。

examples.en: The invitation was under message requests rather than in my main inbox.
examples.zh: 那条邀请在「消息请求」里，主收件箱里没有。

words.enDefinition: the screen listing open chats or recent conversations

examples.en: I found the right group near the top of my conversation list.
examples.zh: 我在「会话列表」靠顶部的位置找到了要找的群。

examples.en: The conversation list showed each group name and its latest message.
examples.zh: 「会话列表」显示了各群名称和最新消息。

words.enDefinition: a linked series of messages belonging to one conversation

examples.en: I returned to the chat thread about the club's practice room.
examples.zh: 我回到讨论社团练习室的「聊天会话」。

examples.en: The chat thread held all the messages about our project meeting.
examples.zh: 有关项目会议的所有消息都在这个「聊天会话」里。

words.enDefinition: a rounded area around an individual chat message

examples.en: I could see the photo inside the message bubble below my reply.
examples.zh: 我能看到回复下方「消息气泡」里的照片。

examples.en: The message bubble became wider after I turned my phone sideways.
examples.zh: 我把手机横过来后，「消息气泡」就变宽了。

words.enDefinition: a sign that another person is composing a message

examples.en: The typing indicator appeared while I waited for my lab partner's reply.
examples.zh: 我等实验搭档回复时，出现了「正在输入提示」。

examples.en: I saw the typing indicator disappear when my classmate sent her message.
examples.zh: 同学发来消息时，我看到「正在输入提示」消失了。

collocations: a typing indicator in a chat

words.enDefinition: an indicator reporting that a recipient has opened a message

examples.en: A read receipt appeared after my classmate opened the message about our meeting.
examples.zh: 同学打开关于开会的那条消息后，显示了「已读回执」。

examples.en: My friend asked where the read receipt appeared beneath the message.
examples.zh: 朋友问「已读回执」会显示在消息下方的哪里。

collocations: a read receipt for a message

words.enDefinition: a short extract showing part of a message before you open it

examples.en: The message preview showed the new rehearsal time beside the club name.
examples.zh: 「消息预览」在社团名称旁显示了新的排练时间。

examples.en: I read the message preview and opened the conversation for more detail.
examples.zh: 我看完「消息预览」，打开会话了解更多细节。

words.enDefinition: the recorded time attached to a message

examples.en: I checked the message timestamp to see whether I had read the latest plan.
examples.zh: 我查看了「消息时间戳」，确认自己看的是不是最新安排。

examples.en: The app showed a message timestamp above the pictures from our trip.
examples.zh: 应用在我们出游照片的上方显示了一个「消息时间戳」。

collocations: a message timestamp in the chat

words.enDefinition: an on-screen line marking where unread messages begin

examples.en: The unread message divider helped me find where I had stopped reading.
examples.zh: 「未读消息分隔线」帮我找到了上次读到的位置。

examples.en: I scrolled to the unread message divider before checking the new schedule.
examples.zh: 我先滚到「未读消息分隔线」，再看新的日程。

collocations: scroll to the unread message divider

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that the message reached its destination

examples.en: The app displayed “Message delivered” under the link I shared with my roommate.
examples.zh: 应用在我发给室友的链接下方显示「消息已送达」。

examples.en: I saw “Message delivered” before my friend had opened the chat.
examples.zh: 朋友还没打开聊天时，我已经看到了「消息已送达」。

words.enDefinition: a status saying that the app could not send a message from the sender's device

examples.en: The screen showed "Message failed to send" when I tried replying with no connection.
examples.zh: 我在没有网络连接时尝试回复，屏幕显示「消息发送失败」。

examples.en: I noticed “Message failed to send” after checking the conversation again.
examples.zh: 我重新查看会话时，发现显示「消息发送失败」。

words.enDefinition: to keep a chat at the top of your conversation list

examples.en: I chose to pin a conversation with my project team for that week.
examples.zh: 那一周，我选择把项目组的「会话置顶」。

examples.en: I found an option to pin a conversation on my own chat list.
examples.zh: 我在自己的聊天列表里找到了「置顶会话」的选项。

collocations: an option to pin a conversation
pin a conversation for quick access

words.enDefinition: to move a conversation out of the main list while keeping it

examples.en: I decided to archive a chat about a project we had already finished.
examples.zh: 我决定把已经结束的项目的「聊天归档」。

examples.en: The help page showed how to archive a chat from the conversation list.
examples.zh: 帮助页面介绍了怎么在会话列表里「归档聊天」。

collocations: be able to archive a chat
archive a chat after a project

words.enDefinition: a small symbol added to an existing message to express a response

examples.en: I used a message reaction to show I had seen the rehearsal plan.
examples.zh: 我加了一个「消息表情回应」，表示已看到排练安排。

examples.en: A message reaction appeared beneath the picture my classmate had shared.
examples.zh: 同学分享的图片下方出现了一个「消息表情回应」。

collocations: a message reaction below a photo

words.enDefinition: to link your response to one particular message in a chat

examples.en: I chose to reply to a specific message so everyone knew which date I meant.
examples.zh: 我选择「回复指定消息」，让大家知道我指的是哪个日期。

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to reply to a specific message in the group.
examples.zh: 室友教我怎样在群里「回复指定消息」。

collocations: choose to reply to a specific message
let users reply to a specific message
reply to a specific message in a group

words.enDefinition: to change the text of a message you already sent

examples.en: After I spotted the typo, I looked for the option to edit a sent message.
examples.zh: 发现错别字后，我找了一下「编辑已发送的消息」的选项。

examples.en: The app gave me an option to edit a sent message in our chat.
examples.zh: 应用把「编辑已发送的消息」选项放在了我们的聊天里。

collocations: choose to edit a sent message
ask how to edit a sent message
an option to edit a sent message

words.enDefinition: to request removal of a message you already sent for other viewers

examples.en: I chose to unsend a message that I had sent to the wrong group.
examples.zh: 我选择「撤回一条消息」，因为刚才发错群了。

examples.en: I checked whether I could unsend a message from our rehearsal chat.
examples.zh: 我确认能不能在排练群里「撤回一条消息」。

collocations: an option to unsend a message
decide whether to unsend a message

words.enDefinition: an option removing a message from your view of a conversation

examples.en: The menu offered “Delete for me” when I held down the message.
examples.zh: 我长按消息时，菜单提供了「仅为自己删除」。

examples.en: I chose “Delete for me” to remove the duplicate from my own view.
examples.zh: 我选了「仅为自己删除」，这样自己就看不到重复的消息了。

words.enDefinition: a label indicating a message was passed on from elsewhere

examples.en: The forwarded label appeared above the timetable when my roommate shared it.
examples.zh: 室友分享时间表时，时间表上方出现了「转发标识」。

examples.en: I noticed the forwarded label before asking where the photo came from.
examples.zh: 我先注意到了「转发标识」，才询问照片从哪儿来的。

collocations: a forwarded label above a message

words.enDefinition: to mark a message so it can be found again quickly

examples.en: I chose to star a message containing the details of our rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我选择「给一条包含排练细节的消息加星标」。

examples.en: My tutor explained how to star a message in the class group.
examples.zh: 导师解释了怎么在班级群里「给消息加星标」。

collocations: an option to star a message

words.enDefinition: to look for particular words or items within one conversation

examples.en: I wanted to search within a chat for the name of the café.
examples.zh: 我想「在聊天内搜索」那家咖啡馆的名字。

examples.en: The app let me search within a chat instead of checking every conversation.
examples.zh: 应用让我能「在聊天内搜索」，省去了查看每个会话的麻烦。

collocations: choose to search within a chat
search within a chat for a word
let users search within a chat

words.enDefinition: an area listing links previously shared in a chat

examples.en: I looked in the shared links tab for the reading group form.
examples.zh: 我在「共享链接标签页」里找读书小组的表单。

examples.en: The shared links tab listed both websites my classmate had mentioned.
examples.zh: 「共享链接标签页」列出了同学提过的两个网站。

collocations: a link in the shared links tab

words.enDefinition: an area collecting photos, clips or other media sent in a chat

examples.en: I found our old picnic pictures in the shared media tab.
examples.zh: 我在「共享媒体标签页」找到了我们以前的野餐照片。

examples.en: The shared media tab showed videos separately from photos in that chat.
examples.zh: 那个聊天的「共享媒体标签页」把视频和照片分开显示。

collocations: a photo in the shared media tab

words.enDefinition: to stop being a member of a group conversation

examples.en: I decided to leave a group chat after the project finished.
examples.zh: 项目结束后，我决定「退出群聊」。

examples.en: My friend checked where to leave a group chat she rarely opened.
examples.zh: 朋友几乎不看那个聊天群，就查了在哪里能「退出群聊」。

collocations: choose to leave a group chat
decide to leave a group chat
an option to leave a group chat

words.enDefinition: a member with permission to manage parts of a group chat

examples.en: The group admin added the new rehearsal link to our chat details.
examples.zh: 「群管理员」把新的排练链接加到了我们群的详细信息里。

examples.en: I asked the group admin to check the spelling of our club name.
examples.zh: 我请「群管理员」核对社团名称的拼写。

words.enDefinition: a web address that opens an invitation to join a group

examples.en: I sent the invite link to the three members who had asked to join.
examples.zh: 那三位成员提出想加入，我就把「邀请链接」发给了他们。

examples.en: The group admin copied the invite link for our new study partner.
examples.zh: 群管理员复制了「邀请链接」，准备发给新学习伙伴。

words.enDefinition: the page showing such details as a group's name and members

examples.en: I opened group info to check the name of the new rehearsal group.
examples.zh: 我打开「群组信息」，查看新排练群叫什么名字。

examples.en: The group info page showed when the reading group had started.
examples.zh: 「群组信息」页面显示了读书小组是什么时候建的。

collocations: details on the group info screen

words.enDefinition: a short explanation of what a group is for

examples.en: The group description said we used the chat mainly to arrange practice.
examples.zh: 「群组简介」里写着，这个群主要用来安排练习。

examples.en: My classmate updated the group description after the club changed its meeting day.
examples.zh: 社团改了活动日期后，同学更新了「群组简介」。

words.enDefinition: to include another person in an existing group chat

examples.en: I asked how to add a group member who had just joined our club.
examples.zh: 我问怎样把刚加入社团的人「添加为群成员」。

examples.en: The settings gave us an option to add a group member by name.
examples.zh: 设置里有个选项，可以按姓名「添加一名群成员」。

collocations: choose to add a group member
ask an admin to add a group member
an option to add a group member

words.enDefinition: to move your view straight to the newest item in a chat

examples.en: I tapped the arrow to jump to the latest message from our club.
examples.zh: 我点了一下箭头，就在社团聊天里「跳转到了最新消息」。

examples.en: My phone let me jump to the latest message after searching through older messages.
examples.zh: 搜索过旧消息后，我的手机让我可以「跳转到最新消息」。

collocations: tap to jump to the latest message
a shortcut to jump to the latest message
choose to jump to the latest message

words.enDefinition: a label showing that the content of a message has been changed

examples.en: I saw the edit indicator beside the corrected date in our chat.
examples.zh: 我在聊天里改过的日期旁看到了「已编辑标识」。

examples.en: The edit indicator appeared after my classmate corrected the room number.
examples.zh: 同学改正房间号后，出现了「已编辑标识」。

collocations: an edit indicator beside a message

words.enDefinition: to copy an address that points to a particular chat message

examples.en: I could copy a message link so the committee could find the timetable.
examples.zh: 我可以「复制一条消息的链接」，让委员会看得到那份时间表。

examples.en: The help page showed me how to copy a message link in our group.
examples.zh: 帮助页面告诉我怎么在群里「复制一条消息的链接」。

collocations: choose to copy a message link
an option to copy a message link
copy a message link for the group

words.enDefinition: the screen used to prepare a new post before publishing

examples.en: I opened the post composer to write a short update for our club.
examples.zh: 我打开「发帖编辑器」，给社团写一条简短动态。

examples.en: The post composer showed the attached pictures below my text.
examples.zh: 「发帖编辑器」在文字下方显示了我附上的图片。

collocations: an option in the post composer

words.enDefinition: the area holding content saved before publication

examples.en: I found yesterday's unfinished announcement in the drafts folder after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在「草稿箱」里找到了昨天没写完的公告。

examples.en: The drafts folder showed two versions of the update about rehearsals.
examples.zh: 「草稿箱」里有两版关于排练的动态。

collocations: a post in the drafts folder

words.enDefinition: to remove an unfinished post you do not want to keep

examples.en: I chose to discard a draft after finding a newer version that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午找到新版本后，我选择「舍弃一份草稿」。

examples.en: The app asked whether I wanted to discard a draft before closing.
examples.zh: 关闭前，应用问我要不要「舍弃一份草稿」。

collocations: decide whether to discard a draft
confirm you want to discard a draft

words.enDefinition: a view showing how content is expected to look when posted

examples.en: The post preview showed that my picture had been cropped too tightly.
examples.zh: 「帖子预览」显示，我的图片裁得太紧了。

examples.en: I opened the post preview before sharing the committee's update.
examples.zh: 分享委员会的动态前，我先打开了「帖子预览」。

collocations: an image in the post preview

words.enDefinition: to make prepared content available to its chosen viewers

examples.en: I wanted to publish a post about the new practice room that evening.
examples.zh: 我那天晚上想「发一条关于新练习室的帖子」。

examples.en: The app asked which page I wanted to publish a post on.
examples.zh: 应用问我想在哪个页面上「发布一条帖子」。

collocations: get ready to publish a post
publish a post on a profile

words.enDefinition: to arrange for a post to appear at a later time

examples.en: We decided to schedule a post for the morning before the club fair.
examples.zh: 我们决定在社团展前的早上「定时发布帖子」。

examples.en: I used the app to schedule a post while drafting the next one.
examples.zh: 我用应用「定时发布帖子」，同时准备下一条的草稿。

collocations: an option to schedule a post

words.enDefinition: to take a published post off your regular profile while keeping a copy

examples.en: I decided to archive a post from the club's old rehearsal schedule.
examples.zh: 我决定把社团旧排练安排的那条「帖子归档」。

examples.en: The profile menu let me archive a post without deleting its text.
examples.zh: 主页菜单让我能「归档帖子」，同时保留帖子的文字。

collocations: an option to archive a post
archive a post from your profile

words.enDefinition: to make a previously archived post visible on your profile again

examples.en: I chose to restore an archived post for our end-of-year photo display.
examples.zh: 为了年末的照片展示，我选择「恢复已归档的帖子」。

examples.en: My classmate asked where to restore an archived post on the club profile.
examples.zh: 同学问，在社团主页哪里可以「恢复已归档的帖子」。

collocations: choose to restore an archived post
an option to restore an archived post
decide whether to restore an archived post

words.enDefinition: to take down a post you published

examples.en: I decided to delete a post when I noticed it was a duplicate.
examples.zh: 发现那条内容重复后，我决定「删除帖子」。

examples.en: The settings explained what happens when you delete a post from your profile.
examples.zh: 设置页面解释了从主页「删除帖子」后会发生什么。

collocations: confirm you want to delete a post
an option to delete a post

words.enDefinition: the space where you type text accompanying a photo or video

examples.en: I added a short description of the rehearsal in the caption field.
examples.zh: 我在「配文输入栏」里加了一段简短的排练说明。

examples.en: The caption field was just below the photos I had selected.
examples.zh: 「配文输入栏」就在我选好的照片下方。

words.enDefinition: a published item containing written text without attached pictures or video

examples.en: I shared a text-only post about the reading group's change of plans.
examples.zh: 我发了条「纯文字帖子」，说读书小组的计划变了。

examples.en: The club used a text-only post to explain the rehearsal schedule.
examples.zh: 社团发了条「纯文字帖子」说明排练安排。

words.enDefinition: a post with several images or clips that viewers can slide through

examples.en: We used a carousel post for the pictures from three club events.
examples.zh: 我们用一条「滑动轮播帖」展示三场社团活动的照片。

examples.en: The last image in the carousel post listed the next practice date.
examples.zh: 这条「滑动轮播帖」最后一张图写了下次练习的日期。

words.enDefinition: a brief video made for quick viewing online

examples.en: I made a short-form video about the crafts we finished that week.
examples.zh: 我把那周做好的手工作品拍成了一个「短视频」。

examples.en: Our club shared a short-form video to introduce its new practice space.
examples.zh: 我们社团发了一个「短视频」，介绍新的练习空间。

words.enDefinition: a video whose image is taller than it is wide

examples.en: I recorded a vertical video because my friends would watch on phones.
examples.zh: 朋友们会在手机上看，所以我录了一个「竖屏视频」。

examples.en: The vertical video showed the whole poster without needing to turn the phone.
examples.zh: 「竖屏视频」能看到整张海报，不用把手机横过来。

words.enDefinition: a still image selected from a video to represent it before playback

examples.en: I chose a cover frame that showed the finished paper flowers.
examples.zh: 我选了画面里有做完的纸花的那一帧，当作「视频封面帧」。

examples.en: The cover frame changed after I edited the beginning of the clip.
examples.zh: 我改了短片开头后，「视频封面帧」变了。

collocations: a cover frame for a clip

words.enDefinition: to shorten a video by removing part of its beginning or end

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to trim a clip before sharing it.
examples.zh: 室友给我演示了怎样在分享前「剪短视频片段」。

examples.en: I decided to trim a clip because the end was too long.
examples.zh: 片尾拖得太长，我决定「剪短视频片段」。

words.enDefinition: an individual update published in a platform's Stories feature, usually visible for a limited time

examples.en: Our club shared a story post after we finished setting up the tables.
examples.zh: 摆好桌子后，社团发了一条「限时动态」。

examples.en: I opened the story post to see the second photo of the garden.
examples.zh: 我点开那条「限时动态」，想看花园的第二张照片。

words.enDefinition: a saved item or group of stories kept visible on a profile

examples.en: The craft club made a story highlight for its previous workshops.
examples.zh: 手作社把之前的工作坊存成了一个「精选动态」。

examples.en: I opened the story highlight on our group's profile after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议结束后，我点开了小组主页的「精选动态」。

collocations: add something to a story highlight

words.enDefinition: to send a response from the screen showing someone's story

examples.en: I chose to reply to a story after seeing my friend's sketch.
examples.zh: 看到朋友的速写后，我选择「回复一条限时动态」。

examples.en: My classmate showed me where to reply to a story on her phone.
examples.zh: 同学指给我看，在她手机上可以在哪里「回复一条限时动态」。

collocations: choose to reply to a story
an option to reply to a story
reply to a story with a message

words.enDefinition: a count of views recorded for a particular story

examples.en: I checked story views after posting the clip from our outdoor rehearsal.
examples.zh: 发完户外排练的短视频后，我查了「限时动态观看次数」。

examples.en: The app showed story views under the picture I had uploaded.
examples.zh: 应用在我上传的照片下面显示了「限时动态观看次数」。

collocations: the total number of story views

words.enDefinition: an interactive element that adds a question with options to content

examples.en: We added a poll sticker to ask which time worked best for rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我们加了个「投票贴纸」，问大家哪个排练时间最方便。

examples.en: I tapped the poll sticker and chose the second option.
examples.zh: 我点了「投票贴纸」，选了第二项。

collocations: answer a question on a poll sticker

words.enDefinition: a clickable sticker that opens a linked page from a post or story

examples.en: The club added a link sticker for the workshop sign-up page.
examples.zh: 社团加了一个通往工作坊报名页的「链接贴纸」。

examples.en: I tapped the link sticker to read the full rehearsal schedule.
examples.zh: 我点了「链接贴纸」，查看完整的排练安排。

collocations: a link sticker in a story

words.enDefinition: a word or phrase preceded by a hash sign to group related posts

examples.en: We used a hashtag to collect everyone's photos from the exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们用同一个「话题标签」汇集大家拍的展览照片。

examples.en: I searched the hashtag to find posts from my sketching group.
examples.zh: 我搜了那个「话题标签」，找速写小组发的帖子。

words.enDefinition: a label associating a post with a selected place

examples.en: I added a location tag for the park where we met.
examples.zh: 我给帖子加了我们见面的公园的「位置标签」。

examples.en: The location tag showed where the study group had taken its photo.
examples.zh: 「位置标签」显示了学习小组在哪儿拍的照片。

words.enDefinition: a small display summarising what a shared link opens

examples.en: The link preview showed the article title under our club's message.
examples.zh: 「链接预览卡片」在社团消息下方显示了文章标题。

examples.en: I removed the link preview because the image looked cropped on my phone.
examples.zh: 预览图在我手机上被裁掉了一部分，我就删了「链接预览卡片」。

collocations: a link preview with an image

words.enDefinition: an option to copy the address of a particular post

examples.en: I tapped “Copy post link” to share the update with my roommate.
examples.zh: 我点了「复制帖子链接」，把动态分享给室友。

examples.en: The menu showed “Copy post link” below the other sharing choices.
examples.zh: 菜单把「复制帖子链接」列在其他分享方式的下方。

words.enDefinition: an option to make prepared content visible as soon as it is submitted

examples.en: I chose “Publish now” once everyone approved the photos in our update.
examples.zh: 大家都同意用这些照片后，我选了「立即发布」。

examples.en: The preview screen offered “Publish now” beside a button for choosing a date.
examples.zh: 预览页面把「立即发布」放在选择日期的按钮旁边。

words.enDefinition: a status showing a moderator is still checking the post

examples.en: The club page showed “Post under review” after I sent in my picture.
examples.zh: 我提交图片后，社团页面显示「帖子正在审核」。

examples.en: I noticed “Post under review” below the title of my announcement.
examples.zh: 我注意到公告标题下方显示「帖子正在审核」。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that a file is being sent to the app

examples.en: The screen showed “Upload in progress” while our club video was being sent.
examples.zh: 我们的社团视频在传输时，屏幕显示「正在上传」。

examples.en: I waited when “Upload in progress” appeared under the photos I had picked.
examples.zh: 选好的照片下方出现「正在上传」时，我等了一会儿。

words.enDefinition: a control for starting to compose another post

examples.en: I selected “New post” to share the first photograph from our walk.
examples.zh: 我点了「新建帖子」，想分享我们散步时拍的第一张照片。

examples.en: The “New post” button sat right above the profile's photo grid.
examples.zh: 「新建帖子」按钮就在主页照片网格的上方。

words.enDefinition: the area below or beside a post where comments appear

examples.en: I opened the comment section to check whether rehearsal had moved.
examples.zh: 我打开「评论区」，看排练时间有没有改。

examples.en: The comment section had useful suggestions from students in other groups.
examples.zh: 「评论区」里有其他小组同学提出的建议。

collocations: a reply in the comment section

words.enDefinition: a comment on the original post rather than on another comment

examples.en: I posted a top-level comment because my question concerned the whole update.
examples.zh: 我的问题和整条动态有关，所以发了一条「一级评论」。

examples.en: The top-level comment showed three replies beneath it on my phone.
examples.zh: 在我的手机上，那条「一级评论」下面显示有三条回复。

collocations: a top-level comment on a post

words.enDefinition: a comment and the linked responses to it

examples.en: The volunteer answered my question in the comment thread below the photo.
examples.zh: 志愿者在照片下方的「评论串」里回答了我的问题。

examples.en: I followed the comment thread until I found the updated meeting time.
examples.zh: 我顺着「评论串」看，找到了更新后的会议时间。

words.enDefinition: an option for expanding the answers attached to a comment

examples.en: I tapped “View replies” to see what the club had written.
examples.zh: 我点了「查看回复」，想看看社团写了什么。

examples.en: The post showed “View replies” below the question about opening hours.
examples.zh: 帖子在营业时间的问题下方显示了「查看回复」。

words.enDefinition: to hide an expanded group of replies from the current view

examples.en: I chose to collapse replies so I could see the next comment.
examples.zh: 我选择「收起回复」，好继续看下一条评论。

examples.en: The app let me collapse replies by tapping the small arrow again.
examples.zh: 我再点一次小箭头，应用就能「收起回复」。

words.enDefinition: an order showing the most recent items above earlier ones

examples.en: I selected “Newest first” to check the comments from that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我选了「最新内容排在前面」，想查看那天下午的评论。

examples.en: The menu offered “Newest first” along with its default sorting option.
examples.zh: 菜单上除了默认排序，还提供了「最新内容排在前面」。

words.enDefinition: comments the app chooses to place prominently by its ranking

examples.en: The top comments included a question about the club's sign-up process.
examples.zh: 「热门评论」里有人问社团怎么报名。

examples.en: I switched from top comments to a view sorted by time.
examples.zh: 我从「热门评论」切换到了按时间排序的视图。

words.enDefinition: a comment chosen to stay near the top of a discussion

examples.en: The pinned comment listed the date of our next book club meeting.
examples.zh: 「置顶评论」写了我们读书会下次见面的日期。

examples.en: I read the pinned comment before asking where the other photos were.
examples.zh: 询问其他照片在哪里之前，我先看了「置顶评论」。

collocations: a pinned comment below a post

words.enDefinition: to change the order in which comments are shown

examples.en: I wanted to sort comments by time to see which comment came last.
examples.zh: 我想按时间「给评论排序」，看看哪条评论最后发出。

examples.en: The menu let me sort comments before reading the responses to my post.
examples.zh: 我读帖子回复之前，可以先用菜单「给评论排序」。

words.enDefinition: the number of comments recorded for a post

examples.en: The comment count changed after I reopened the club's photo album.
examples.zh: 我重新打开社团的相册后，「评论数量」变了。

examples.en: The app put the comment count beside the small speech bubble.
examples.zh: 应用把「评论数量」放在小对话气泡旁边。

collocations: the comment count on a post

words.enDefinition: the number of likes currently shown or recorded for content

examples.en: I checked the like count while looking at the club's recent posts.
examples.zh: 我浏览社团近期帖子时，看了「点赞数」。

examples.en: The like count appeared next to the heart below the photo.
examples.zh: 「点赞数」显示在照片下方爱心的旁边。

collocations: a like count below a post

words.enDefinition: to keep the total number of likes from appearing in view

examples.en: I chose to hide the like count on the photos from our exhibition.
examples.zh: 我选择对展览照片「隐藏点赞数」。

examples.en: The options let me hide the like count before sharing the picture.
examples.zh: 我分享图片之前，可以在选项里「隐藏点赞数」。

collocations: choose to hide the like count
an option to hide the like count
hide the like count on a post

words.enDefinition: to prevent people from adding comments to a post

examples.en: The group decided to turn off comments on its old announcement.
examples.zh: 小组决定给那条旧公告「关闭评论」。

examples.en: I checked where to turn off comments before archiving the page.
examples.zh: 归档页面前，我确认了在哪里可以「关闭评论」。

collocations: turn off comments on a post
an option to turn off comments

words.enDefinition: to limit which people are allowed to respond to a post

examples.en: I chose to restrict replies to the members who followed the group.
examples.zh: 我选择「限制谁可以回复」，只有关注本组的成员可以回复。

examples.en: The club could restrict replies when posting practice notes for its members.
examples.zh: 社团发布成员练习记录时，可以「限制谁可以回复」。

words.enDefinition: to delete a comment you posted or have permission to manage

examples.en: I asked the club admin how to remove a comment I had duplicated.
examples.zh: 我问社团管理员，怎样「移除自己重复发出的那条评论」。

examples.en: The organiser chose to remove a comment that repeated an older meeting time.
examples.zh: 组织者选择「移除那条还在重复旧会面时间的评论」。

collocations: be allowed to remove a comment
an option to remove a comment

words.enDefinition: a label showing someone referenced your account in their text

examples.en: I saw “Mentioned you” beside the student's comment on our club photo.
examples.zh: 我在同学对社团照片的评论旁看到了「提到了你」。

examples.en: The app showed “Mentioned you” next to the text about the workshop.
examples.zh: 应用在工作坊相关文字旁显示「提到了你」。

words.enDefinition: to add a post to a list you can revisit later

examples.en: I decided to bookmark a post about the Saturday craft workshop.
examples.zh: 我决定「收藏一条关于周六手作工作坊的帖子」。

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to bookmark a post on the app.
examples.zh: 室友教我怎样在应用里「收藏一条帖子」。

words.enDefinition: a list of posts you have bookmarked

examples.en: I opened saved posts to find yesterday's recipe from the cooking club.
examples.zh: 我打开「已收藏的帖子」，找烹饪社昨天发的菜谱。

examples.en: The picture was in saved posts under the event's original caption.
examples.zh: 那张图在「已收藏的帖子」里，保留了活动原来的配文。

words.enDefinition: a named group of posts saved together

examples.en: I added the sketching post to my saved collection of drawing ideas.
examples.zh: 我把这条速写帖子加进了我的绘画灵感「收藏合集」。

examples.en: The saved collection helped me find the club's older tutorials again.
examples.zh: 「收藏合集」帮我重新找到了社团以前的教程。

collocations: add a post to a saved collection

words.enDefinition: the main stream of posts shown when an app opens

examples.en: My home feed showed two photos from our society's exhibition that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早晨，我的「首页信息流」显示了两张社团展览的照片。

examples.en: I went back to the home feed after reading the comments.
examples.zh: 看完评论后，我回到了「首页信息流」。

collocations: a post in the home feed

words.enDefinition: a stream of posts from accounts you follow

examples.en: I switched to the following feed to find the club's latest post.
examples.zh: 我切换到「关注账号信息流」，找社团最新发的帖子。

examples.en: The following feed included posts from both of the groups I had joined.
examples.zh: 「关注账号信息流」里有我加入的两个小组发的帖子。

collocations: a post in the following feed

words.enDefinition: a feed arranged by posting time rather than by recommendations

examples.en: I chose the chronological feed to see the updates in time order.
examples.zh: 我选择「按时间排序的信息流」，按发出时间看动态。

examples.en: The chronological feed showed my friend's latest painting first that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，「按时间排序的信息流」先显示了朋友最新的画作。

words.enDefinition: an area for browsing content from sources you might not follow

examples.en: I found the pottery club in the explore tab while looking for workshops.
examples.zh: 我找工作坊时，在「发现标签页」找到了陶艺社。

examples.en: The explore tab displayed short clips organised by topic that day.
examples.zh: 那天，「发现标签页」按主题展示了一些短片。

collocations: find a post in the explore tab

words.enDefinition: a post offered by the app based on what might interest you

examples.en: A suggested post showed how another club organised its reading group.
examples.zh: 一条「推荐帖子」介绍了另一个社团怎样组织读书小组。

examples.en: I opened a suggested post about weekend walks near the university.
examples.zh: 我打开一条讲周末在大学附近散步的「推荐帖子」。

collocations: a suggested post in the feed

words.enDefinition: a post that someone pays to have shown to more viewers

examples.en: I saw a sponsored post for an exhibition in the city centre.
examples.zh: 我看见一条介绍市中心展览的「付费推广帖子」。

examples.en: The sponsored post had a small label above the first photo.
examples.zh: 那条「付费推广帖子」的第一张照片上方有个小标识。

collocations: a sponsored post in the feed

words.enDefinition: to share someone else's post again with your own viewers

examples.en: I asked the craft group whether I could repost its workshop announcement.
examples.zh: 我问手作小组，能不能「转发他们的工作坊公告」。

examples.en: My classmate chose to repost the club's invitation for her study group.
examples.zh: 同学选择「转发社团发的邀请帖」给学习小组看。

words.enDefinition: a new post that embeds another post with your own text

examples.en: Her quote post added a note about which rehearsal was open.
examples.zh: 她在「带评语的引用转发」里说明了哪次排练对外开放。

examples.en: I read the quote post because it explained the picture's background.
examples.zh: 我看了那条「带评语的引用转发」，因为它解释了图片的来历。

words.zhGloss: 分享到自己的限时动态
words.enDefinition: to post an existing item in your personal story area
acceptedZhAnswers: 分享到自己的限时动态

examples.en: The app showed how to share to your story from the club page.
examples.zh: 应用演示了怎样从社团页面「分享到自己的限时动态」。

examples.en: I saw the option to share to your story below the photograph.
examples.zh: 我在照片下方看到了「分享到自己的限时动态」的选项。

collocations: an option to share to your story

words.enDefinition: a feedback option saying you want fewer similar items recommended

examples.en: I tapped “Not interested” on a suggested post about an unrelated subject.
examples.zh: 我在一条无关主题的推荐帖子上点了「不感兴趣」。

examples.en: The menu offered “Not interested” below the other recommendation options.
examples.zh: 菜单把「不感兴趣」列在其他推荐选项下方。

words.enDefinition: an option to stop showing a post in your own feed

examples.en: I selected “Hide from feed” when I saw the duplicate announcement.
examples.zh: 我看到重复公告时，选了「不在信息流中显示」。

examples.en: The menu showed “Hide from feed” beside the option to save.
examples.zh: 菜单把「不在信息流中显示」放在收藏选项旁。

words.enDefinition: to remove the like you previously gave a post

examples.en: I tried to unlike a post after tapping the heart by accident.
examples.zh: 不小心点到爱心后，我试着「取消给帖子的点赞」。

examples.en: The help page showed how to unlike a post from the feed.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说明了怎样在信息流里「取消给帖子的点赞」。

collocations: tap again to unlike a post
be able to unlike a post

words.enDefinition: to choose to see more posts marked with a particular topic tag

examples.en: I decided to follow a hashtag used by the students' drawing group.
examples.zh: 我决定「关注学生绘画小组用的一个话题标签」。

examples.en: The app let me follow a hashtag for the community garden.
examples.zh: 应用让我可以「关注社区花园的话题标签」。

collocations: follow a hashtag for an event

words.enDefinition: a tab that opens a particular stream of posts

examples.en: I tapped the feed tab after updating the details on our page.
examples.zh: 更新完页面资料后，我点了「信息流标签页」。

examples.en: The feed tab was just to the left of my profile.
examples.zh: 「信息流标签页」就在个人主页入口的左边。
